Title: Великие Минеи Четии, собранные всероссийским митрополитом Макарием. [Вып. 3]. Сентябрь, дни 25-30 (the Great Menaion of Readings compiled by Metropolitan Macarius of All Russia, September 25-30); host catalogue title, the OCR title page being partly garbled
Creator: Compiled by Macarius, Metropolitan of All Russia (title: "всероссийским митрополитом Макарием"; host creator: Макарий); published by the Archaeographic Commission. Texts inside: the Life of Saint Sergius of Radonezh, whose hagiographer names himself in the text as Pachomius ("мне недостойному Пахомию", file line 5033), and the Praise of Sergius ascribed by the volume to his disciple Epiphanius ("священноинокомъ Епифанемъ", file line 12159).
Publisher: Saint Petersburg: Typography of the Imperial Academy of Sciences, for the Archaeographic Commission (series Памятники славяно-русской письменности); title page read in the OCR
Publication Date: 1883 (host date; the OCR of the title page prints the year as "1888", and the volume's series page announces the index to the first three volumes for 1884)
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: pd-us-by-date. A nineteenth-century Saint Petersburg imprint: the host date is 1883, the OCR title page reads "1888", and a series page in the volume announces an index "въ 1884 году". Every reading is before 1931. The item record carries no possible-copyright-status or licence field.
Language: chu
Source: Internet Archive item velikiemineichetiisobrannyevserossijski92 (archive.org/details/velikiemineichetiisobrannyevserossijski92), full-text file velikiemineichetiisobrannyevserossijski92_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the Library thread, October 2026.
Provenance note: Header prepended; the host text follows unchanged. Nothing was normalised, stripped, corrected, re-spaced or retyped. OCR sampled at 5, 50 and 95 percent: readable Church Slavonic in the civil type of 1883, with systematic substitutions (the letter yat read as Ь, Б or Ф; i read as "!", "1" or "Т"; some words broken across lines). The text is a Slavonic redaction, not a modern Russian one.
Content note: The September 25 section of Macarius's Menaion for Saint Sergius. Order: contents list for the whole volume (file lines 163 to 258); the day heading for September 25 (first at 497); "Житие и жизнь ... Сергия" in Pachomius's redaction from file line 1363 to 12158 (printed columns 1408 to 1562 by the volume's own index); then "слово похвално преподобному отцю нашему Сергию, сотворено бысть ученикомъ его, священноинокомъ Епифанемъ" from 12159 to about 13358 (columns 1563 to 1580), the Epiphanius text the census calls the movement's founding hagiography as it survives. The rest of the file holds the other saints of September 25 to 30 (John the Theologian from about 13848). Epiphanius's own first Life of Sergius is not preserved as such; the census says it survives through Pachomius's reworkings, and this volume is one of them. Second witness for exact wording until a quote is checked against the page images.
